landing.heroTitle: Effortlessly craft and share your dream wishlist
landing.heroText: Curate a list that reflects what you actually want, keep a few things private, and share it with a single link. No hassle, no account needed to view.
landing.featuresTitle: Create, share, and stay up to date
landing.featuresText: Everything you need for birthdays, weddings and just-because moments.

create.title: Effortless creation
create.text: Add items with a photo, a link and an average price. Crafting your dream list has never been easier.

privacy.title: Privacy on your terms
privacy.text: Mark any item as private and it stays just between you and your list. You decide what the world sees.

sharing.title: Sharing without strings
sharing.text: Send a single link. Viewers don't need an account to see what you're hoping for.

connected.title: Stay connected
connected.text: Follow friends and family and keep their lists in one place, so you always know what to give.

landing.closingText: Create your wishlist, share your dreams, and make gift-giving a little more thoughtful.
landing.footer: Questions or ideas? Reach out on <linkedin>LinkedIn</linkedin>.

signIn.asideTitle: A quieter way to share what you wish for.
